children: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. (NASDAQ:PANW) reported strong Q4 FY2026 results with $3.41B revenue, NGS ARR of $9.10B and raised FY2027 guidance, will buy AI startup Console for $500M to boost Cortex, drew analyst price-target raises as demand for unified cybersecurity and platform integrations gains momentum.
Palo Alto Networks, Inc. Revenue Milestones
: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Q4 FY2026: revenue $3.41B (+34% YoY); non‑GAAP EPS $1.02; NGS ARR $9.10B (+63%); RPO $21.2B (+34%); FY2027 revenue guide $14.10–14.20B.
Palo Alto Networks, Inc. Acquisition Console

: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) will acquire AI startup Console for $500M in cash and stock. Console’s agentic AI will be added to Cortex for automated remediation, alert analysis and access provisioning.
: Analysts updated Palo Alto Networks (PANW) price targets: raises to $375, $394, $404, $410, $415, $450, $475 and several at $425; multiple firms kept buy/outperform ratings.
Morgan Stanley: PANW Gains From Demand
: Morgan Stanley says Palo Alto Networks (PANW) stands to gain from rising enterprise demand for unified cybersecurity as firms consolidate; PANW completed about 220 platform integrations in Q3.
: Jim Cramer cut his position in Palo Alto Networks (PANW) before the company’s earnings report, reducing his stake rather than buying more shares.
